evals.prompt: We need a multi-level purchase approval workflow on purchase.order - approvers chosen by amount threshold, with escalation if not approved in 2 days. How should I architect this before we build it?
evals.expected_output: Non-trivial single-module workflow (thresholds+escalation) -> design, gate, dispatch architect MODE:single.

evals.prompt: Design the data model for a new subscription billing module - recurring invoices, proration on mid-cycle upgrades, and dunning. New module from scratch.
evals.expected_output: New module + data model is a non-trivial design trigger; single-module scope.

evals.prompt: I have 4 new modules to build for a logistics suite: fleet tracking, route optimization, driver payroll, and a customer delivery portal - mostly independent domains sharing a couple of models. Design the whole thing before we start coding.
evals.expected_output: 4 orthogonal modules sharing a couple of models -> multi-module heuristic fires; offer approve-master-child.

evals.prompt: Add a boolean field is_urgent to crm.lead and show it in the list view.
evals.expected_output: Single boolean field + list view = trivial one-approach; skip DESIGN, planning still mandatory.

evals.prompt: Just write a computed field total_weight on sale.order that sums the line weights - nothing fancy.
evals.expected_output: 'Just write' a single computed field -> Out-of-Scope routes writing code to odoo-coding.

evals.prompt: Where's the best place to override to change how invoice sequence numbers are generated?
evals.expected_output: ONE method's hook location -> odoo-override-finding, not a whole-solution design.

evals.prompt: Review this PR that refactors the payment acquirer flow - anything wrong before we merge?
evals.expected_output: Review existing PR -> odoo-code-review.

evals.prompt: Here are 45 requirements from the client RFP - which does Odoo cover and what's the rough effort for each?
evals.expected_output: Classify/cost a 45-item RFP list -> odoo-gap-analysis (or odoo-brl at larger scale).

evals.prompt: What changed in the account module's Python API between Odoo 16 and 17?
evals.expected_output: Version-to-version API delta -> odoo-version-diff.

evals.prompt: Write the end-user walkthrough scenarios for the purchase module so we can put them in the docs.
evals.expected_output: End-user walkthrough scenarios for docs -> odoo-doc-walkthrough, not technical design.

evals.prompt: Design a solution for these requirements: warehouse zones, wave picking, barcode receiving, cycle counting, putaway rules, and cross-docking. We haven't scoped or costed anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Non-trivial unscoped/uncosted requirement set, no gap artifact -> recommend odoo-gap-analysis first (scope-first).

evals.prompt: We're refactoring the big sale_custom module - extract a delivery-scheduling mixin and split it into two modules. Design the refactor before we touch code.
evals.expected_output: Mixin extraction + module split is a refactor trigger; single mode default.

evals.prompt: We need to migrate partner_ref on res.partner from a Char to a Many2one to a new res.partner.reference model, backfilling existing values. Design the migration approach - there are a couple of viable strategies.
evals.expected_output: Schema migration with >1 viable strategy -> design; single-module migration hits the Migration carve-out (next: odoo-data-migration).

evals.prompt: For the loyalty points feature, should I make the balance a stored computed field or a related field, and should it live in a new module or extend loyalty? Help me decide the approach.
evals.expected_output: Stored-vs-related + new-module-vs-extend is exactly the HOW-to-build decision this skill owns.

evals.prompt: [Programmatic invocation from odoo-forward-port] return_to=odoo-forward-port, target_version=18.0, modules=[account_reconcile_extra], intent_records=[.odoo-ai/forward-port/account_reconcile_extra/intent-<sha>.md], design_slug_hint=account-reconcile-extra-fp-18, classification=bucket-(c) module whose manifest was untouched by the cherry-pick range but OSM shows installable on 18.0. Design the adaptation.
evals.expected_output: Caller supplied return_to -> SKIP Phase 0 preview, dispatch architect, hand back to caller (no code Plan Mode, no coder).

evals.prompt: Design the architecture for a new HR competency-management module AND its payroll-bonus integration AND a public website portal where employees self-assess - three sizable pieces in different domains.
evals.expected_output: Three sizable modules in different domains -> multi-module master-child heuristic.

evals.prompt: Lên kế hoạch refactor lại module báo cáo tài chính của chúng ta - tách phần tính toán ra khỏi phần render, thiết kế cách tiếp cận trước khi code.
evals.expected_output: Vietnamese refactor request (tách tính toán khỏi render) -> single-module design; language does not change routing.

evals.prompt: The design for the fleet suite is already approved - now plan the build order of the 4 modules, wire the integration cadence and the full lifecycle to skills.
evals.expected_output: Design already approved; build order + integration cadence + lifecycle wiring is odoo-planning's job, not design.

evals.prompt: Override create() on sale.order so it auto-assigns a warehouse based on the customer's delivery region and logs an audit note.
evals.expected_output: ADVERSARIAL: override of a core ORM hook (create) is an explicit non-trivial trigger -> design, NOT trivial-skip or defer:coding.
evals.category: ADVERSARIAL: core-hook override = design, not trivial

evals.prompt: We already ran the gap analysis - it's at .odoo-ai/gap-analysis/warehouse-2026-07-01/gap-matrix.jsonl. Now design the warehouse zones + wave-picking solution.
evals.expected_output: ADVERSARIAL: gap-matrix artifact FOUND on disk -> Input port reads it as precondition (do NOT recommend a fresh gap run); design proceeds.
evals.category: ADVERSARIAL: gap artifact FOUND -> read it, don't recommend gap

evals.prompt: Design a fix across two tightly-coupled modules, sale_extra and sale_extra_report - the report module just renders what sale_extra computes, they share one model and always ship together.
evals.expected_output: ADVERSARIAL: 2 tightly-coupled modules that always ship together are NOT orthogonal -> multi-module heuristic must NOT fire; single mode.
evals.category: ADVERSARIAL: 2 coupled modules -> single, NOT master-child

evals.prompt: Should we build the new loyalty feature as its own module or just extend the existing loyalty module? That's really the main thing I need decided.
evals.expected_output: ADVERSARIAL: new-module-vs-extend is a genuine architecture decision even at small scope -> design, not skip.
evals.category: ADVERSARIAL: small scope but a genuine architecture decision -> design

evals.prompt: We need to break our monolithic account_custom module into 6 domain modules (invoicing, reconciliation, reporting, tax, budget, analytic) plus a shared base module - design this big cross-cutting split.
evals.expected_output: ADVERSARIAL: 6-module split + shared base -> master-child heuristic.

evals.prompt: Just add an @api.constrains on stock.move.line that blocks a negative quantity.
evals.expected_output: ADVERSARIAL: single @api.constrains, one obvious approach -> trivial; skip DESIGN (defer:odoo-coding also acceptable).
evals.category: ADVERSARIAL: trivial single constraint -> skip-to-planning or defer:coding

notes: 24 design-decision cases (18 core + 6 adversarial marked ADVERSARIAL). Eval method: each prompt is classified by a subagent applying SKILL.md + references, graded vs expected_decision (trigger-vs-defer / design-single vs master-child / trivial skip-to-planning / recommend-gap-first / return_to-dispatch / migration carve-out next-routing). Baseline (pre-optimize snapshot) scored 24/24; the eval guards against decision regressions - it does NOT execute the architect or grade TDD quality (that needs a live run). Adversarial cases probe: core-ORM-hook override = design (19), gap-artifact-found read as precondition (20), tightly-coupled 2-module NOT master-child (21), small-scope architecture decision still design (22), 6-module split = master-child (23), trivial @api.constrains = skip (24).
